home.title: Skill Workbench
home.subtitle: Pick an existing skill card to maintain it, or click "Create Skill" to start a new one via conversational wizard.
home.searchPlaceholder: Search by skill name, description or slug...
home.createSubtitle: Generate SKILL.md and a flowchart through AI dialogue

create.guideSubtitle: Tell the AI your full SOP / methodology / FAQ. The more structured your input, the closer the generated SKILL.md and flowchart will be to production-ready.
create.suggestionSopDesc: Walk through every step, decision point, and input/output
create.suggestionSopPrompt:
I want to create a skill called "XXX" for the following scenario: ...
Here is the full SOP — please generate SKILL.md and FLOWCHART.md accordingly:
1. Trigger: ...
2. Step 1: ... (input / action / output)
3. Step 2: ...
4. Decision branch: if ... then ...; otherwise ...
5. Definition of done: ...
create.suggestionMethodDesc: Good for analysis, review or consulting skills — give the AI the framework and deliverables
create.suggestionMethodPrompt:
Turn the following methodology into a skill:
- Name: ...
- Applicable scenarios: ...
- Core principles: ...
- Dimensions / checklist: ...
- Output format: ...
Please generate SKILL.md and the matching flowchart.
create.suggestionFaqDesc: Ideal for support/sales skills — organise as "question → recommended answer"
create.suggestionFaqPrompt:
I want to create an FAQ-style skill. Typical Q&A:
1. Q: ...
   A: ...
2. Q: ...
   A: ...
Please organise these into a proper SKILL.md and generate a handling flowchart.
create.tip: Tip: feel free to paste raw docs / SOPs / meeting notes — the AI will structure them for you. After submitting, SKILL.md and FLOWCHART.md will be written into the workspace skill directory.
